_doc: Crop regions of GFX/Sprites/brainbosshd.png (1448x1086) to animate as live overlay patches on the Brain final boss. box = [tx0,ty0,tx1,ty1] in TEXTURE pixels. ALL boxes must have ty0 >= ~400 so they stay below the top-of-screen cutoff (the boss draws at design (400,100), textureScale ~1.703 -> texture rows < ~373 are off-screen; 373 is the hard limit, ~400 is the margin). seed pins the i2v render; negative overrides gen_brain_anims.DEFAULT_NEGATIVE (the anti-camera-motion prompt). fps + triggerAvgSeconds are PLAYBACK knobs, re-synced into the manifest on every build_brain_overlays.py run, so they retune without re-rendering. Candidates are generated by gen_brain_anims.py; only the winners get wired by build_brain_overlays.py. SHIPPING (in the manifest): eye_reveal, pods_flicker. GENERATED-BUT-REJECTED candidates kept for reference / retuning: flesh_breathe (subtle; same box as eye_reveal, superseded by it), ring_left (whole-ring camera drift), lens_right (the iris never stopped clashing with the static art around it).

regions.name: flesh_breathe
regions.prompt: Extreme close-up of glistening wet fleshy brain tissue, the deep folds and convolutions slowly pulsating and breathing, subtle organic throbbing, moist shiny surface, veins faintly twitching under the skin. Locked static camera, no camera motion, no zoom, the frame edges stay perfectly still. Dark biomechanical horror, cinematic.

regions.name: pods_flicker
regions.prompt: Static locked-off shot of a cluster of glowing blue sci-fi mechanical ports and lenses on dark metal. Nothing moves except the light: the glow flickers and pulses, indicator LEDs blink, tiny electrical arcs crackle across the ports, energy hums through the machinery. The metal housing itself stays completely rigid -- it does not shift, breathe or resize. Locked static tripod camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no pan, the frame edges stay perfectly still. Cinematic biomechanical detail.

regions.name: lens_right
regions.prompt: Close-up of a single glowing blue mechanical iris lens set in dark metal, the aperture blades slowly rotating and dilating, the blue core pulsing brighter and dimmer, faint scanning light sweeping. Locked static camera, no camera movement, no zoom, frame edges perfectly still. Sci-fi cybernetic detail.

regions.name: ring_left
regions.prompt: Close-up of a heavy dark metal ribbed mechanical ring joint where a thick cable plugs into machinery, the ring slowly turning, small red and blue indicator lights flickering, mechanical segments subtly shifting and venting. Locked static camera, no camera movement, no zoom, frame edges perfectly still. Cinematic sci-fi hardware.

regions.name: eye_reveal
regions.prompt: Extreme close-up of wet fleshy brain tissue; a slit between the folds slowly parts open to reveal a single glistening organic eyeball that blinks and looks slowly from side to side, then the fold relaxes. Moist shiny surface, veins twitching. Locked static camera, no camera movement, no zoom, frame edges perfectly still. Body-horror, cinematic.
